## About
Williams (formerly Folger) Automotive Collision Center is part of the Williams Automotive Group and sits on site at Williams Subaru in Charlotte. We're a Subaru Certified Collision Center, ASE certified and I-CAR Gold Class, and we're the preferred body shop and collision center of AAA Carolinas.
Unibody work is checked with laser frame and computerized measuring tools, and we handle the insurance side with you, from the estimate to the claim. We serve Charlotte, Matthews, Monroe, Mint Hill and Indian Trail.
We're rated 4.8 from 145 Google reviews. One reviewer thanked Marie Proctor and Mike Fletcher by name, along with everyone who worked on her car.

## Services
- Dent, scratch, and paint removal: Dents, scratches and paint damage repaired and refinished.
- Frame and unibody repair: Unibody repairs checked with laser frame and computerized measuring tools, backed by a lifetime guarantee.
- Windshield and auto glass replacement: Replacement windshields and auto glass.
- Online estimate: Take photos of the damage and send them in for an estimate.
- Consultations and computerized estimates: Stop by or book an estimate appointment and we'll look the car over.
- Drive-in insurance claims services: Bring the car in and we'll help with the claim and all dealings with your insurance company.
- Mobile claims services for fleet accounts: Claims handled on location for fleet accounts.
- Rental car and loaner help: We can help you get a rental car, and we provide loaners when available.

## FAQ
Q: Who decides where my car gets repaired?
A: You do. You have the right to choose where you get your car repaired.

Q: Do I need to get more than one estimate?
A: No law requires you to get more than one estimate.

Q: Do you work with insurance companies?
A: Yes. All insurance company estimates are honored, and we're a direct repair facility for most of the major insurance carriers.

Q: Do you repair makes other than Subaru?
A: Yes. We're certified and specialized in Subaru, Buick and GMC, but we repair all makes and models.

Q: When is the collision center open?
A: Monday through Friday. We're closed Saturdays and Sundays.
